global_principles: Optical clarity over decorative flair: Follow a strict 'Stripe / Apple' inspired visual language.
Data Density with Breathing Room: Use generous padding inside cards (p-6, p-8) while keeping information strictly organized.
Subtlety in Depth: Shadows must be nearly invisible, providing just enough lift to separate surfaces.
Restrained Palette: Absolutely no bright, distracting colors outside of the primary accent (#2563EB) and semantic status indicators.

rules: Never use Inter. Use Manrope for that crisp, geometric, premium SaaS aesthetic.
Table headers must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), with wide tracking (tracking-wider).
Numbers in tables or metrics should ideally use tabular nums (tabular-nums utility).

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-[#2563EB] text-white rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-blue-500/20 active:translate-y-0
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900

inputs.text: w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 transition-all focus:border-[#2563EB] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none placeholder:text-slate-400
inputs.textarea: w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 transition-all focus:border-[#2563EB] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none min-h-[120px] placeholder:text-slate-400

table.wrapper: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white
table.th: px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider
table.td: px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-100

upload_zone.base: w-full border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl p-12 text-center transition-all hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-[#2563EB] cursor-pointer group flex flex-col items-center justify-center

badges.success: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-100

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use default Inter font. Ensure Manrope is imported from Google Fonts and applied globally.
Adhere strictly to the 'Soft Utility' aesthetic: rounded corners (xl/2xl), pure white cards, and off-white (F8FAFC) backgrounds. Avoid any dark mode elements unless strictly required.
Implement the Layout Pattern: Use a fixed left sidebar (collapsible on mobile) and a top header. The content area should have a max-width and be horizontally centered for ultra-wide screens.
Tables MUST be clean: No vertical borders. Use generous padding (px-6 py-4) to make data readable.
Buttons and Interactive elements MUST have subtle Y-axis translations on hover (hover:-translate-y-[1px]) paired with a soft shadow. This gives the 'Apple/Stripe' tactile feel.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements, forms, links, and action buttons.
For the Upload Component, ensure it handles drag-and-drop visually by changing border color and background when a file is hovered over it.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default square/sharp styling with the rounded-xl and rounded-2xl utility classes defined in these guidelines.
For toast notifications, use Sonner with a clean, white, softly shadowed card style.
Do NOT use bright red or green for huge blocks of color. Use the subtle semantic colors (e.g., emerald-50 bg with emerald-700 text) for status badges.
